title: Modular and data-driven generation
summary: Expand a versioned pattern or data schema over validated outlines and module metadata, using proxy placement before exceptional geometry and engine packaging.

use_when: footprints, patterns, module kits, or data tables drive assembly
avoid_when: the input schema is unknown and cannot be inspected

inputs: versioned module metadata and pattern/data schema
outputs: collision and metadata products as requested
acceptance: instances and unique geometry remain separated
rollback: remove or undo only the namespaced generator network
